name: singular-orchestration
description: Operate Singular (CLI: gluerun) multi-agent orchestration — author DAG plans, run autonomous parallel agent loops, and monitor L0/L1/L2 state through the read-only console/dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Operate Singular (gluerun) agents, plans, tasks, gates — with a live dashboard/console viewer.
interface.longDescription: An operator skill plus local console (dashboard/viewer/visualization UI, started idempotently with `gluerun console --ensure`) for Singular (formerly glueRun-go) orchestration. The skill teaches an agent to set up a repo, author parallel DAG plans and planner contracts, run the autonomous loop at maximum parallelization, promote gates, and recover stuck runs. The console (0.7.0) is a full-bleed workspace with four surfaces behind a slim header: Home (system-at-a-glance landing — health, attention feed, gate progress, 14-day activity, quick links), a Plan workbench over the DAG (execution-timeline Gantt with real per-attempt bars and gate marks, dependency matrix, layered stage graph, task table, node drilldown aside), a Consoles operations room (persistent L0 supervisor stream plus dynamic role/task-labeled agent consoles that collapse to a recent rail), and an Agents role grid with EDITABLE settings (model/effort/concurrency knobs written to gluerun.config.json env{} with when-it-applies labels). Developer primitives throughout: role prompt templates and the exact rendered prompt of any run, plus {} view-source buttons exposing the raw durable file behind every entity (tasks, leases, dispatch records, gates, breaker, backoff, config, DAG). Plan threads (0.8.0): when a DAG completes, `gluerun plan archive` snapshots it as a browsable read-only thread; a header switcher and Home card let you revisit archived plans chat-style while a fresh plan runs. Orchestration state itself stays read-only. Deployed sub-agents are derived from durable facts only.
defaultPrompt: Run the Singular orchestration on this repo.
Open the Singular orchestration console and show L0/L1/L2 status.
